text: Italy's unemployment rate fell from 11.9% in 2015 to 7.7% in 2023.
why: Regression: a whole year on a monthly series was read as one month (2015-01, 2023-12).

claims.quote: Italy's unemployment rate fell from 11.9% in 2015 to 7.7% in 2023
claims.justification: Yearly averages of the monthly series: 12.02 (2015) and 7.68 (2023), within 0.5 points of 11.9 and 7.7; the rate fell.

text: In 2011 Italy's youth unemployment was 29%; today it is 43.3%.
why: Regression: the monthly youth series was turned down for being monthly, and 'today it is 43.3%' lost its value.

claims.justification: The 2011 average of the monthly youth rate is 29.19, within 0.5 points of 29.
No date is given, so 'today' is the latest month: 19.9 in 2026-09 (Eurostat, updated 2026-11-05), far from 43.3.
